name: Bichlalm
kurzbeschreibung: Sunny Bichlalm (1,600 m) above Kitzbühel features a single-chair lift, panoramic alpine lodge, and scenic walking trails.
preis: Bichlalmbahn return ticket adults approx. €24.00; Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card valid
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to late October daily 09:00 to 17:00; winter operations for ski tourers
beschreibung:
Overview

The scenic and historic Bichlalm perches at an elevation of 1,600 meters on the sun-blessed southern slopes of the Kitzbühel Alps above Kitzbühel and Aurach. Renowned as one of the most serene and panoramic retreats in the region, this sunny alpine plateau attracts nature lovers, hikers, and peaceful wanderers away from busier hubs. From the expansive sun terrace of the modern alpine lodge, visitors gaze across a breathtaking 360-degree panorama taking in the prominent Kitzbüheler Horn, the Hahnenkamm, the rugged limestone towers of the Wilder Kaiser, and the glaciated peaks of the Hohe Tauern. In summer, lush meadows and Swiss stone pine forests invite leisurely mountain rambles, while winter transforms the Bichlalm into a legendary sanctuary for guided ski touring and exclusive snowcat freeriding.

Route & Requirements

Ascending to the Bichlalm is a scenic and peaceful experience aboard the modern single-chair lift of the Bichlalmbahn, gliding gently over green pastures and fragrant mountain forests to the high plateau. Energetic hikers can also ascend on foot from the valley terminal along well-marked forest and alpine pasture roads (approx. 1.5 to 2 hours walking time, 600 meters of elevation). The trail network surrounding the alp offers gentle family walks across rolling meadows as well as rewarding ridge hikes, such as the crossing to the Stuckkogel (1,888 m) or Hochkogel. Casual walking shoes with profiled soles suffice for local walks, while sturdy ankle-high hiking boots and windproof clothing are recommended for alpine crest trails.

Visit & Arrival

The Bichlalmbahn operates daily during the summer season from mid-May to late October from 09:00 to 17:00; the mountain inn provides year-round dining and overnight accommodation. Chairlift rides are included in the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card and KitzSki passes. By car from Kitzbühel, take the B161 towards Pass Thurn, branch left shortly before Aurach, and follow the Bichlalmstraße up to the valley station car park. Kitzbühel town buses and hiking shuttles run regularly to the lift terminal.

Tips

Savour an authentic Tyrolean Gröstl or freshly caught local brook trout on the sun deck of Almgasthof Bichlalm while admiring views of the Kaisergebirge. Early risers can ride the morning lift during the golden hour to photograph stunning alpine light across the surrounding summits.
